system.description:
Orc armor (heavy mail equivalent) at Orc Resources prices. Clumsy weight: Agility +2 Ob, Climbing +1 Ob, Health/Forte for fatigue +1 Ob, Throwing and Shooting +2 Ob, Stealthy +1 Ob, Swimming +2 Ob, Speed -1D, Perception/Observation +1 Ob (helmet). Without Armor Training: +1 Ob to all tests.

Poor quality: all 1s rolled count for losing armor dice. Costs half the run of the mill price (rounded up). Orcs may purchase armor piecemeal as described in the Human Resources section.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 242
